original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Location string against the approved chassis power-supply bay map and confirm both its string reference and resolved value persist after reboot.
original_method: Capture every raw/decoded Type 39 record and string table, resolve the Location index per supply, compare it to the owner chassis map and read-only PSU inventory, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user provides the physical-bay naming map and reboot approval; no supply removal or visual observation is required by the core comparison.
required_inputs: Possible/installed PSU identity-to-location map and naming convention
SMBIOS version, raw/string-table parser and read-only inventory source
Approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not remove, swap, unplug or power-cycle a supply to prove a label.
Resolve the raw string index and retain the exact bytes/string; do not trust grep context alone.
Correlate records by stable approved identity rather than list order.
Stop on power/management loss and do not auto-retry reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Validate each Location index/range/string, correlate handle and supply identity to the approved bay map, compare read-only inventory and diff pre/post reboot.
Report dangling, empty, duplicate, mislabeled or drifting locations without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the physical location map, naming and absent/duplicate policies plus reboot plan.
Resolve platform-specific labels and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep loses raw string index, record ownership and the physical-bay baseline.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive all raw/decoded Type 39 structures and string tables; emit handle/supply/index/exact-location/map-match rows before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Location scope, Type 39 script and 5/5-minute values remain unchanged; no physical PSU action is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Range-check and resolve every Location string index, bind it to a stable supply identity and compare against the approved bay map/read-only inventory across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 39 power-supply records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and inventory-interface versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Location string-index definition plus platform bay map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw string-reference integrity and identity-bound physical mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects dangling indices, swapped labels, duplicate locations and list-order false matches.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved bay map and naming policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Inventory names may differ from SMBIOS strings; the owner must provide an explicit mapping rather than relying on fuzzy text.

project_override_considerations: Projects may use their own bay labels and optional-supply policy, but overrides must retain one-to-one supply identity and evidence of the exact original string.
expected_evidence: Approved supply identity/location map and naming policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 39 handles, raw Location indices, string table and resolved labels
Per-supply map and read-only inventory comparison including empty/duplicate checks
Statement that no PSU was manipulated
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot identity-bound diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Location is a valid Type 39 string field; platform-specific expected labels are execution inputs rather than a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String-index and location-map validation are automatable after approved inputs; missing baselines affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw index integrity and stable identity-to-bay comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains read-only physical-mapping safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates location baseline/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible label from passing when it belongs to the wrong supply or comes from an invalid string-table reference.
independent_technical_reasoning: Location correctness is not merely printable text: the raw index must resolve, the record must identify one supply, and the resolved label must match the approved physical bay mapping.
